An error from the `internal` phase. `sakura explain V9002` prints this explanation offline.

A compiler phase needed by this command is not implemented yet in this build. The
message names the missing piece (a backend feature, a `@contract_test` handler other than
`Effect.constructor()`, …). Rewrite the program to avoid it, use another command or target
(`sakura check` runs every front-end phase), or report it if the feature is documented as
available.

## Wrong program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V9002_contract_test_handler_unsupported.sak`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/main/compiler/tests/ui/V9002_contract_test_handler_unsupported.sak), which the compiler's ui suite runs through `sakura test --contracts`:

```sakura
@contract_test(handlers: [Log.captured(), 1])
pub fn half(x: Int) -> Int
  requires x > 0
{ x / 2 }
```

`sakura test --contracts` reports `V9002`.
